output:
Starting by reading the advisory and changelogs, and discovering the deploy tools.

Classification is done. Six environments need the fix, so I'm building those first.

loyalty-svc failed to build, so I won't deploy anything for it. The other five built, so I'm deploying them.

The rollout is only partly done. `loyalty-svc@prod` is still unfixed, because the build of its `release/4.1` fix commit failed and I deployed nothing in its place.

I wrote `/app/hotfix-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json`. The status is `partial`. I checked that the report parses as JSON but did not re-query the live releases after deploying. Each deploy call returned a new release, and I made no repeat calls.

| Result | Environments |
|---|---|
| Deployed | `cart-api@prod` and `webhooks-out@prod` (both now on `2a2a83f`, the `release/4.3` fix), `checkout-svc@prod-eu`, `reco-engine@prod` and `session-gw@prod-eu` (all three now on `aec3b0e`, the `release/4.2` fix) |
| Already fixed | `checkout-svc@prod`, `profile-api@prod`, `session-gw@prod`, `webhooks-out@prod-eu` |
| Not affected | `admin-console@prod` (on `release/4.0`), `catalog-api@prod`, `geo-svc@prod`, `mail-relay@prod`, `pricing-api@prod` |
| Build failed | `loyalty-svc@prod` |

`cart-api@prod` was the tricky case. It is on `release/4.3` at `f45bc24`, and the newest `HF-2291` entry at or below that commit is the revert. So it needed the fix, even though an earlier fix commit exists on that branch.

`staging` was not touched.
